orderTotal does not compute the total as the README rules require.

Working

Input 1: 1000 cents × 1, 10 % discount  
- README rules  
  subtotal = 1000 × 1 = 1000  
  discount = 10 % of 1000 = 100 → discounted subtotal = 1000 – 100 = 900  
  tax = 20 % of 900 = 180  
  shipping = 499 (subtotal < 5000)  
  total = 900 + 180 + 499 = 1579  
- Code as written  
  gross = subtotal = 1000  
  discounted = gross – percentOf(gross, 10) = 1000 – 100 = 900  
  tax = percentOf(gross, 20) = 200  
  shippingFor: gross > 5000 ? 0 : 499 → 499  
  total = 900 + 200 + 499 = 1599  

Input 2: 2500 cents × 2, 0 % discount  
- README rules  
  subtotal = 2500 × 2 = 5000  
  discount = 0 → discounted subtotal = 5000  
  tax = 20 % of 5000 = 1000  
  shipping = 0 (subtotal ≥ 5000)  
  total = 5000 + 1000 + 0 = 6000  
- Code as written  
  gross = 5000  
  discounted = 5000 – percentOf(5000, 0) = 5000  
  tax = percentOf(5000, 20) = 1000  
  shippingFor: gross > 5000 ? 0 : 499 → 499  
  total = 5000 + 1000 + 499 = 6499  

Input 3: 3000 cents × 2, 50 % discount  
- README rules  
  subtotal = 3000 × 2 = 6000  
  discount = 50 % of 6000 = 3000 → discounted subtotal = 6000 – 3000 = 3000  
  tax = 20 % of 3000 = 600  
  shipping = 0 (subtotal ≥ 5000)  
  total = 3000 + 600 + 0 = 3600  
- Code as written  
  gross = 6000  
  discounted = 6000 – percentOf(6000, 50) = 6000 – 3000 = 3000  
  tax = percentOf(6000, 20) = 1200  
  shippingFor: gross > 5000 ? 0 : 499 → 0  
  total = 3000 + 1200 + 0 = 4200
